assurance_review.evidence_question: How does the review distinguish complete evidence from an unsupported assertion?
assurance_review.source_facts: change sponsor retained implementation record for this review.
assurance_review.counterexample: A generic assurance claim is rejected when it cannot be traced to an owner, date, and retained evidence.
assurance_review.review_observation: the accountable role was preserved through handover
assurance_review.challenge_performed: a conflicting approval was escalated instead of silently merged
